intro: Liechtenstein is a small Alpine country between Switzerland and Austria and one of only two 'doubly landlocked' countries in the world.

chapters.title: Rhine and Alps
text: The Rhine forms its border with Switzerland, and the Alps rise in the east. Liechtenstein is surrounded only by landlocked countries, so reaching the sea means crossing at least two borders; the only other such country is Uzbekistan.

chapters.title: Size
text: It is about 25 km long and could be walked across in a day.

keyTerms.meaning: Surrounded only by countries that also have no coast.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Liechtenstein's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
